configuration.scope: Conditional local-screen illustrations from the shared base configuration. All intrinsic brightness and local screen assumptions remain explicit; no measured local variance or receiver-noise amplitude is inferred.

covariance.scope: Illustrative conditional foreground screens, not inferred local plasma statistics. All intrinsic amplitude, angular structure, E/B and turnover parameters are assumptions. No mixed-depth real-beam or receiver-noise result is implied.

scope: Shared-column mixed-depth moments at native 10/30/50 MHz and all three parent/zoom responses at 30/50 MHz. Gaussian draws use separate smooth/centered components; full visibility Gaussianity is not asserted.
